purpose: Exhaustive, lossless route mapping of all 340 Handbook nested source details onto provisional groups, explicit prior master relations or remaining contextual review without automatically proving same-identity.
methodology: Only use deterministic source-observation parent links, earlier explicit source-to-master relationships, original group's manually recorded master candidate, and the 24 manually adjudicated unindexed groups. No fuzzy title matching, no semantic auto-merge.
